displayName: Data Alerts - Cloud Run job execution failed

conditions.displayName: At least one failed job execution in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id="fxr-analytics" AND resource.labels.location="us-central1" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result="failed" AND resource.labels.job_name=one_of("sync-hourly-ploy-to-bigquery", "monthly-vat-report", "refresh-daily-tracking-events-chargebee", "sync-user-plan-fields-to-chargebee", "upload-weekly-usage-events-to-chargebee", "send-weekly-activity-to-appcues", "load-weekly-chargebee-predictions-from-sftp", "upload-weekly-events-to-chargebee-backfill")

documentation.content:
A Cloud Run job execution failed after its configured retries. Job: ${resource.label.job_name}. Check the execution and logs before retrying to avoid duplicate external writes.

https://console.cloud.google.com/run/jobs/details/us-central1/${resource.label.job_name}/executions?project=fxr-analytics

This policy detects failed executions; it does not detect missed schedules. Incident closure is not proof of a successful rerun.
